data.title: 尤贝尔 · 海边捡到的有趣贝壳
data.description: 【黑沙海湾·午后】尤贝尔穿着深绿色分层泳装，赤脚蹲在潮线旁挑选形状古怪的贝壳；她举起一枚像魔法符号的贝壳端详，海浪突然漫过脚踝，侧马尾和裙摆一起被风吹向身后。
data.location: black-sand cove beneath a forest cliff
data.action: 潮线旁挑选古怪贝壳，海浪漫过脚踝后举起“有趣”的收藏
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun through sea mist
data.mood: 把假日当作观察实验的魔法使
data.promptProse: Übel from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End wears a deep green layered swimsuit with a short black beach skirt, shell jewelry and bare feet. She crouches at the tide line and sorts strange shells into a little wooden tray, choosing the one with the most curious shape. When a wave reaches her ankles she lifts the prize toward the viewer with an easy smile, her green side ponytail streaming in the salt wind. soft afternoon sun through sea mist.
